input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms (renewal term length is acceptable), but the only exit after the Initial Term requires ninety (90) days' written notice. That is the effective non-renewal notice window, and 90 days exceeds the fallback ceiling of 60 days, so the clause fails the fallback on a material term (it sits at the outer edge of walk-away territory). We propose shortening the window to 30 days and clarifying it operates as a non-renewal election, with 60 days offered as a fallback. Note (not separately flagged): there is no renewal price-uplift language at all, so no cap is needed today; if Kubient adds renewal pricing we would seek the lesser of CPI and 3%. The absence of a 60-day vendor reminder is likewise a minor sub-element noted only.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement, or elect not to renew the then-current Term, for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the post-Initial Term notice window from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days and confirmed it operates as a non-renewal election, since our playbook allows automatic twelve-month renewals only with an exit on 30 days' notice (60 days at the outside). We can live with 60 days if that is easier for you.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal/termination notice window after Initial Term from 90 to 30 days
